camel_example: aliyun rds CreateDdrInstance --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '5.6' --DBInstanceNetType Intranet --SecurityIPList '127.0.0.1' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType Prepaid --RestoreType BackupSet --Engine MySQL
description_en: Restores data to a new instance across regions
description_zh: 该接口用于跨地域恢复数据到新实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-ddr-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine MySQL --engine-version 5.6 --db-instance-net-type Intranet --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1 --pay-type Prepaid --restore-type BackupSet --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDdrInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the destination instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the destination instance. Valid values:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库类型，取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The major engine version of the destination instance. The value of this parameter varies based on the value of Engine.

Valid values when Engine is set to MySQL: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0
Valid values when Engine is set to SQLServer: 2008r2, 08r2_ent_ha, 2012, 2012_ent_ha, 2012_std_ha, 2012_web, 2014_std_ha, 2016_ent_ha, 2016_std_ha, 2016_web, 2017_std_ha, 2017_ent, 2019_std_ha, and 2019_ent
Valid values when Engine is set to PostgreSQL: 9.4, 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, and 13.0
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库版本。根据Engine参数取值的不同，本参数取值如下：
MySQL：5.5/5.6/5.7/8.0
SQL Server：2008r2（高性能本地盘，已停售）/08r2_ent_ha（云盘版，已停售）/2012/2012_ent_ha/2012_std_ha/2012_web/2014_std_ha/2016_ent_ha/2016_std_ha/2016_web/2017_std_ha/2017_ent/2019_std_ha/2019_ent
PostgreSQL：10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0

SQL Server实例中`_ent`表示企业集群版、`_ent_ha`表示企业版、`_std_ha`表示标准版、`_web`表示Web版
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the destination instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例规格，详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the destination instance. Valid values: 5 to 2000. Unit: GB. You can increase the storage capacity at a step size of 5 GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例存储空间，取值：5~2000。
每5 GB进行递增，单位：GB。详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The character set of the destination instance. Valid values:

utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的字符集，取值：
utf8
gbk
latin1
utf8mb4
parameters.name: system_db_charset

parameters.help_en:
The network connection type of the destination instance. Valid values:

Internet
Intranet
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络连接类型，取值：
Internet：公网连接
Intranet：内网连接
parameters.name: db_instance_net_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.

The value cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The IP address whitelist of the destination instance. If you want to add more than one entry to the IP address whitelist, separate the entries with commas (,). Each entry must be unique. You can add a maximum of 1,000 entries. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html. The entries in the IP address whitelist must be in one of the following formats:

IP address. Example: 10.23.12.24.
CIDR block. Example: 10.23.12.24/24. In this example, 24 indicates that the prefix of the CIDR block is 24 bits in length. You can replace 24 with a value that ranges from 1 to 32
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html，多个IP地址请以半角逗号（,）隔开，不可重复，最多1000个。支持如下两种格式：
IP地址形式，例如：10.23.12.24。
CIDR形式，例如：10.23.12.24/24（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the destination instance. If the destination instance is deployed in multiple zones, separate the IDs of the zones with colons (:).

If you specify a virtual private cloud (VPC) and a vSwitch, you must specify this parameter to identify the zone for the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的可用区ID。多可用区用英文冒号（:）分隔。

指定了VPC和交换机时，为匹配交换机对应的可用区，该参数必填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

VPC
Classic

Default value: Classic.

If you set this parameter to VPC, you must also specify VpcId and VSwitchId
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络类型，取值：

VPC：VPC网络
Classic：经典网络（已下线）

选择VPC时，还需要传入参数VpcId、VSwitchId
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The connection mode of the destination instance. Valid values:

Standard: standard mode
Safe: database proxy mode

Default value: Standard
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的访问模式，取值：

Standard（默认值）：标准访问模式
Safe：数据库代理模式
parameters.name: connection_mode

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the destination instance. This parameter is available only when you set the InstanceNetworkType parameter to VPC.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的VPC ID。

当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必填。
传入此参数后，后续还需传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID of the destination instance. If you specify more than one vSwitch, separate the IDs of the vSwitches with commas (,). This parameter is available only when you set the InstanceNetworkType parameter to VPC.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the ZoneId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的虚拟交换机ID，多个值用半角逗号（,）隔开。

当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必填。
传入此参数后，后续还需传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the destination instance. The private IP address must be within the CIDR block that is supported by the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns an internal IP address based on the values of the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置目标实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance.

If you set Period to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 3.
If you set Period to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 9.

If you set PayType to Prepaid, you must specify UsedTime
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~3。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

若付费类型为Prepaid，本参数必填
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit that is used to measure the subscription duration of the destination instance. Valid values:

Year
Month

If you set PayType to Prepaid, you must specify UsedTime
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费目标实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若付费类型为Prepaid，本参数必填
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The restoration method that you want to use. Valid values:

BackupSet: restores data from a backup set. If you use this value, you must also specify BackupSetId.
BackupTime: restores data to a point in time. If you use this value, you must also specify RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：

BackupSet：基于备份集恢复，恢复备份集内的数据到新实例。您还需要传入参数BackupSetId。
BackupTime：基于时间点恢复，恢复日志备份保留时间内的任意时间点的数据。您还需要传入参数RestoreTime、SourceRegion、SourceDBInstanceName
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID that you want to use for the restoration. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query backup set ID.

This parameter is required when you set the RestoreType parameter to BackupSet
parameters.help_zh:
基于备份集恢复时，使用的备份集的ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查看备份集ID。
RestoreType=BackupSet时，本参数必填
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the backup set is located
parameters.help_zh: 备份集所在地域
parameters.name: backup_set_region

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time that you specify must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If RestoreType is set to BackupTime, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 基于时间点恢复时，要恢复的时间节点，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the source instance if you want to restore data to a point in time.

If you set RestoreType to BackupTime, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源地域的ID。
RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The source instance ID, which is used if you want to restore data to a point in time.

This parameter is required when you set the RestoreType parameter to BackupTime
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源实例的ID。
RestoreType=BackupTime时，本参数必填
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The storage type of the destination instance. Only the local SSD storage type is supported. Default value: local_ssd
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例存储类型，取值：
建议和源实例的存储类型保持一致。
<details>
<summary>RDS MySQL</summary>

local_ssd：高性能本地盘（默认值）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）
</details>

<details>
<summary>RDS SQL Server</summary>

cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
local_ssd：高性能本地盘（已停止售卖）
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）

</details>

<details>
<summary>RDS PostgreSQL</summary>

cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
local_ssd：高性能本地盘（已停止售卖）
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（已停止售卖）

</details>
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) that is provided by your Alibaba Cloud account for Resource Access Management (RAM) users. RAM users can use the ARN to connect to ApsaraDB RDS to Key Management Service (KMS). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628797.html operation to query the ARN.

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
parameters.help_zh: SQL Server实例主账号授权RDS云服务账号访问KMS权限的全局资源描述符（ARN）。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628797.html接口查看ARN信息
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the customer master key (CMK) for cloud disk encryption. If this parameter is specified, cloud disk encryption is enabled and you must also specify the RoleARN parameter. Cloud disk encryption cannot be disabled after it is enabled. You can obtain the ID of the key in the KMS console or create a key. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181610.html.

**

Notes

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances.

You can leave this parameter empty. If you do not specify this parameter, you only need to specify the RoleARN to use the service key that is managed by ApsaraDB RDS to encrypt cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例用户自定义云盘加密的密钥ID。传入此参数表示开启云盘加密（开启后无法关闭），并且需要传入RoleARN。
您可以在密钥管理服务控制台查看密钥ID，也可以https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181610.html。

您也可不传此参数，仅需要传入RoleARN，表示设置实例的云盘加密类型为RDS托管的服务密钥（Default Service CMK）
parameters.name: encryption_key

ConnectionString.description_en:
The endpoint that is used to connect to the destination instance.

The DBInstanceNetType parameter indicates whether the endpoint is internal or public
ConnectionString.description_zh:
新实例连接地址。
参数DBInstanceNetType决定该地址为内网或外网

Port.description_en:
The port number that is used to connect to the destination instance.

DBInstanceNetType indicates whether the port is internal or public
Port.description_zh:
新实例连接端口。
参数DBInstanceNetType决定该端口为内网端口或外网端口
